name: AI Document Processing | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## AI Document Processing
Reads invoices and receipts (PDF or photo) from **email** or an **upload form**, extracts the data with AI, checks it, files the document in Google Drive and logs it in Google Sheets. Anything that does not add up is flagged for review.
1. Fill in **Settings** (Drive folder ID is the last part of the folder URL).
2. Make a Google Sheet with a **Documents** tab (columns in `documents-sheet.csv`).
3. Connect Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and OpenAI. 4. Activate.
